purpose: svapaṭhanārtham (for the scribe's own reading); written by the grace of Saṃkaṭā Devī near the Vidyeśvara shrine
notes: Scribe's name written bhairaviśaraṇena (cataloguer marks !), i.e. Bhairavīśaraṇa, agreeing with the catalogue field. Saṃkaṭā Devī and Vidyeśvara are deities/shrines in Kāśī, not persons. No date in the colophon.
